provenance: Extracted 12 October 2026 from the ACCEPTANCE.md tables embedded in COMPLETE-SPEC.md Part 10 (the standalone ACCEPTANCE.md is absent from this workspace). Scenario text verbatim from the tables. due_milestone and evidence_layers are the implementer's assignment read from MILESTONES.md and the M0-M6 exit criteria; changing them requires slice review. status reflects the M0 baseline: NOT_IMPLEMENTED for cases due at M0, DEFERRED_BY_PLAN for cases due later. No entry is PASS without executed evidence. Per-case status_detail annotations record the M0 slice closeout (plans/m0-milestone-report.md); status field remains the visibility vocabulary, never a self-awarded pass.
